categories.title: Authorization Before Sensitive Operations
categories.description: A sensitive operation must be dominated by an authorization decision that covers the acting principal, requested action, and protected resource.

categories.title: Operating System Command Construction
categories.description: Externally influenced data must not alter the control structure or executable selection of an operating system command.

categories.title: Dynamic Code Construction
categories.description: Externally influenced data must not become directives or executable structure in dynamically evaluated code.

categories.title: Filesystem Path Confinement
categories.description: Externally influenced path components must remain confined to the intended filesystem boundary after canonical resolution.

categories.title: Outbound Request Destination Policy
categories.description: Server-side outbound request destinations must be derived from or constrained by an explicit trusted destination policy.

categories.title: Redirect Destination Policy
categories.description: Redirect destinations influenced by external input must be restricted to trusted locations before the redirect response is emitted.

categories.title: SQL Command Construction
categories.description: Externally influenced values must remain data parameters and must not alter the control structure of an SQL command.
